_readme: Hand-entered beer deals and places, committed to git so we can both add to it.
Use this for deals we've seen in person, on a chalkboard, on Instagram, or got from the owner.
Match a place by its exact name (as shown in the app) plus 'near' [lat, lng], or by 'venueId' (shown in the app's place details).
kind: regular | happy_hour | game_day | special. days: 0=Sun..6=Sat. start/end: 24h 'HH:MM'.
game_day deals also need team 'Padres' and gameDayRule 'game_day' (any day they play) or 'after_win' (day after a win).
source 'team' = we confirmed it with the bar ourselves (shows a 'Verified' badge).
Delete the example entries below once we have real ones; they're marked 'example': true and ignored.
